sense: a page of days, weeks and months

pins.definition: A chart, book, or digital app showing the days, weeks, and months of the year.
A chart, book, or app showing the days, weeks, and months of a year, or used to record appointments.
A chart, series of pages, or digital app showing the days, weeks, and months of a year, or a system for organizing dates.

situation: An office worker is counting down the days until a vacation by crossing off dates on a wall-mounted chart.
subject: the calendar
brief: A layered papercraft diorama shows a wall-mounted calendar made of overlapping paper sheets, where a hand holds a marker in the process of crossing through the squares of a month grid. The grid is clearly structured into neat rows of weeks and columns of days, with each day as a distinct paper tile, emphasizing the sequential, time-keeping nature of the object.
prompt: A layered papercraft diorama shows a wall-mounted calendar made of overlapping paper sheets, where a hand holds a marker in the process of crossing through the squares of a month grid. The grid is clearly structured into neat rows of weeks and columns of days, with each day as a distinct paper tile, emphasizing the sequential, time-keeping nature of the object. layered cut paper filling the whole frame, real depth between the layers, crisp cast shadows, visibly fibrous card and translucent tissue, raking side light. Never a box, a shadow-box or a picture frame around the scene — the paper IS the world, not an object sitting inside one. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
